cat.title: LIU Post 2026-2027 Undergraduate & Graduate Catalog - Admission (freshman and international admission, English minimums, deadlines)

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT may be submitted but are optional for most LIU programs; for international applicants, SAT/ACT scores may be submitted in lieu of language-test scores (SAT Reading 460 or ACT English 18). SAT code 2369, ACT code 2792.

requirements.notes: Apply at liu.edu/apply or with the Common App; $50 non-refundable fee (catalog). Required: official secondary records with certified English translation and English proof unless exempt. The catalog lists one teacher/counselor recommendation, personal statement and resume as optional for international applicants, while the LIU FAQ says undergraduates submit two recommendation letters and an essay or writing sample; confirm with admissions. Some programs require a portfolio or audition. International students must pay the tuition deposit to receive the I-20; the I-20 application needs bank statements or sponsor proof plus a passport copy.

deadlines.label: Early Action (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Catalog freshman section; notification 'begins' Dec. 1. Printed without a year, so the 2026-27 cycle (fall 2027 entry) is assumed. Not stated whether international applicants use it.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Binding plan listed in the catalog freshman section; notification 'begins' Jan. 2. Printed without a year, so fall 2027 entry is assumed.

deadlines.label: Merit scholarship and housing consideration date, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Catalog: submit by Dec. 1 for fall (Oct. 1 for spring) to be considered for all departmental and merit scholarships and on-campus housing. Printed without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Catalog: international applications by May 1 for fall or Nov. 1 for spring; LIU reviews on a rolling basis. Printed without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The old Brooklyn page recommends applying 5-12 months before the start date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Proof of English proficiency is required unless waived; English as the primary language of high school instruction satisfies it (Global/Brooklyn page). The catalog also accepts SAT Critical Reading 460 or ACT English 18, or completion of LIU English Language Institute Level 8; SAT/ACT may be submitted instead of language scores. Some academic programs require higher scores or prior U.S. university coursework. LIU runs an English Language Institute on the Brooklyn campus; no conditional-admission terms are published on the pages read.

english.notes: Undergraduate minimum; some programs may require more. The pages do not give a new 1-6 scale minimum.
Undergraduate minimum per the 2026-27 catalog (graduate 58); not listed on the Global/Brooklyn page.

cost.notes: Annual undergraduate tuition (24-36 credits) $41,874; full-time university fee $2,116; standard double room $12,384 plus Residential Meal Plan One $6,554 (housing and food is their sum); student health insurance charge $2,158 and $150 dining dollars are listed separately. Same rates apply to international students. College Navigator lists books at $2,000 (2024-25)

aid.notes: LIU FAQ: international students are eligible for merit-based scholarships and are automatically reviewed by the admissions committee at admission. No award amounts are published for international freshmen; scholarships apply to tuition only and are renewable subject to a GPA minimum. Federal and state aid are not available to international students; whether any institutional need-based aid exists for them is not stated.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code was found on the LIU pages read.

duolingo.note: Scores are shared through Duolingo; no code is listed.

pte.note: Scores are shared through Pearson; no code is listed.

tier_notes.general: Our estimate: an 86% admit rate (fall 2024) with SAT section medians of 620 EBRW / 600 Math among the 24% who submit, and a New York campus, place it just above the open-access D tier.
